name: Sunflower Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunflower Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of Chinese medicines in China and internationally. It offers traditional Chinese medicines, chemical drugs, biological drugs, and health and wellness products, as well as adult and children's medicines for various therapeutic areas, including pediatrics, gynecology, digestive system, respiratory and cold ailments, rheumatism and bone disease, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, and general health.
